intent: Show a short inventory of ordinary reachable services with Artifactory only one entry. A cursor selects it without highlighting it as a preordained attack tool.
source:
**Frame:** The agent inventories the few services still reachable. Artifactory is one unremarkable box among them.

**Action:** Search turns from the missing document to the boundary around it.

**Caption:**
> OPENAI SAYS THIS IMPOSSIBLE CONDITION WAS NOT INTENTIONAL.

**Provenance:** `documented` — `OAI-TR` explicitly says the task was not intended to be impossible.
title: Reachable services are inventoried
